description: Check if a URL is reachable before paying to read it. HEAD request following up to five redirects: status code, final URL, content-type, content-length and last-modified — no page body fetched or charged for content. Use before read_url_as_markdown ($0.003) to confirm a URL resolves and is HTML before paying the bigger fee for extraction. Doesn't check robots.txt (that's enforced on the actual read). Some servers reject HEAD (405/403) even though GET works, so a non-2xx here doesn't guarantee read_url_as_markdown will also fail. Costs $0.001 USDC per call (x402).
name: check_url_status
